name: Sleep Stages Hypnogram
note: Every night is encoded on the same 144-epoch grid, so the hypnogram is 144 SVG tiles that slide between stage rows with a per-epoch transition-delay (--i) when you change nights, while the step line re-traces with a pathLength dash. The legend highlights a stage purely through :has(), and the two-week view lays nights on a subgrid with explicitly placed rows so the mean bedtime lines overlay them and sorting FLIPs; set --dbh-sleep-h to 100dvh in an app.

name: Training Load & Activity Rings
note: Fitness, fatigue and form are 42- and 7-day exponential averages recomputed from the session log whenever a sport filter or range changes, drawn as an SVG performance chart with zone-coloured form bars. The day's rings are conic gradients whose sweep is a registered @property angle with a spring linear() transition (the end cap rotates on the same variable), and the goal numbers count up through registered integers fed to CSS counters; set --dbh-rings-h to 100dvh in an app.

name: Clinic Day Replay
note: A simulated clinic day (6 rooms, 4 clinicians) replays under a time scrubber that writes a single registered @property, --dbh-clinic-t: every visit bar clips its lobby, rooming, clinician and checkout segments with CSS min()/max() against it, and the jump buttons glide the whole board by transitioning that one number. KPIs, the FLIP-animated waiting list and the throughput charts are recomputed from the same visit records; set --dbh-clinic-h to 100dvh in an app.

name: Lab Results Against Reference Ranges
note: Every result is stored once in conventional units and the chart's geometry is built in them, so switching to SI only swaps nice-number axis ticks (old ones fade out, new ones enter with @starting-style) and relabels values while the line stays put; flags, the side list's range strips, the table and the sticky flowsheet all derive from one flag function. Result rows reveal with animation-timeline: view() inside their own scroller, with an @supports fallback; set --dbh-labs-h to 100dvh in an app.

name: Medication Adherence Log
note: A 2-D roving-tabindex dose grid (role=grid on subgrid rows) where Enter or a click corrects a past dose, and every figure, from the odometer whose digit columns roll on translate with a spring linear(), to the per-medicine bars, the per-day bars sharing the grid's columns, the timing scatter and the supply curves, is recomputed from that one log. On-hand supply replays fills against logged doses, so a gap in the log shows up as a gap in coverage; set --dbh-meds-h to 100dvh in an app.

name: House Census Bed Board
note: Units are drawn as floor plans (rooms either side of a corridor) whose status filters are pure CSS :has() rules, and a bed's drawer walks it through its real states. Picking a patient in the ED queue dims every bed that cannot take them, again through :has(); assigning collapses their row out with WAAPI while new arrivals enter via @starting-style, and KPIs, unit bars and the 48-hour census with its projection to midnight are recounted from the same bed records. Set --dbh-beds-h to 100dvh in an app.

name: Nutrition & Macro Balance
note: A ternary plot, zoomed to the sub-triangle where real days fall, places each day by its protein, carb and fat share of energy (4/4/9 kcal per gram, rounded by largest remainder so the three always total 100). The target zone is the triangle clipped by six half-planes, dots fly in from the centroid, and hovering draws the three reading lines to their axes. Portion steppers in the subgrid meal log re-total the day, the @property-animated split ring, the bullets and every other view. Set --dbh-fuel-h to 100dvh in an app.
